comparison.augmentation: historical Dconst01 with its registered augmentation enabled
comparison.pairing: same dataset and training seed; aggregate metrics at each arm's legally validation-selected checkpoint
comparison.selection_protocol: historical validation Macro AUC, strict improvement with earliest tie, patience10, max50epochs
comparison.historical_raw_p_status: MISSING; no row-paired confidence interval may be claimed

eligible_evidence.checkpoint: selected by the frozen historical validation Macro AUC rule
identity_checks: same natural historical data, outer split and evaluation row identity
same source-fixed model initialization and intended training protocol, except the registered augmentation toggle
same constant loss weight, Equal-style aggregation, batch40960, optimizer and stopping/selection rule
software, PyTorch, CUDA, dtype, AMP and TF32 identities are recorded for both arms
a known environmental difference is not silently treated as matched; only an already reviewed compatibility resolution may qualify it, otherwise attribution is unresolved

extension_rule.expression: identity_comparable AND all_required_metrics_finite AND d_auc_2022 > 0 AND d_auc_2023 > 0 AND mean_d_ll <= 0
extension_rule.auc_requirement: strictly positive augmentation increment in both registered development seeds
extension_rule.logloss_safeguard: augmentation does not worsen validation Macro LogLoss averaged equally over the two seeds
extension_rule.auc_tie: does not satisfy repeated positive direction
extension_rule.arithmetic: use stored full-precision finite scalars, without displayed-value rounding or result-dependent tolerance
extension_rule.interpretation: conservative resource rule for the already registered extension; not significance, equivalence, efficacy or an independent-data confirmation

if_rule_passes.required_execution: complete both registered locked seeds using the same frozen historical protocol; compare with already identified matching historical augmented metrics

if_rule_fails.interpretation: does not prove augmentation ineffective, equivalent or harmful in general; no additional seed, arm, baseline or numeric threshold is introduced

prohibited_decision_inputs: training loss or stopping epoch as a substitute for selected validation performance
a better result from another historical arm or selected subset of seeds
required_reporting: both seed-level validation Macro AUC and Macro LogLoss values and augmentation-minus-no-augmentation differences
equal-seed mean differences, individual LogLoss signs and checkpoint epochs
identity/comparability receipt and explicit environmental limitations
all test/terminal contrasts reported only after the decision is frozen, as separate exposed-benchmark observations
a passing mean LogLoss safeguard may coexist with one seed's LogLoss harm; report that harm and do not claim repeated LogLoss improvement
validation is already used for checkpoint selection, so this extension is exploratory resource allocation rather than independent confirmation
no original-row paired interval without actual historical paired predictions
